run_fuse_scale_shift_kernel: run fuse_scale_shift_kernel to apply scale and shift to a tensor with optional scalar or 3D/4D parameters
run_fuse_layernorm_scale_shift_gate_sele: run fuse_layernorm_scale_shift_gate_select01_kernel to fuse layernorm with scale shift and conditional gate selection between two parameter sets
run_fuse_residual_layernorm_scale_shift_: run fuse_residual_layernorm_scale_shift_gate_select01_kernel to fuse residual addition, layernorm, scale shift, and conditional gate selection in one kernel
run_fused_scale_shift_4d_kernel: run fused_scale_shift_4d_kernel to apply per-frame scale and per-token shift on normalized tensor data
run_fuse_scale_shift_kernel_blc_opt: run fuse_scale_shift_kernel_blc_opt to apply scale and shift with configurable block dimensions for BLC-optimized execution
